tool.name: lavToPsl
tool.description: convert LASTZ LAV alignments to PSL or BED
tool.command: ## a complete LASTZ LAV file ends with "#:eof"; lavToPsl does not check this ( test ! -s '$input' || test "\$(tail -c 6 '$input')" = '#:eof' || ( echo 'The LAV input does not end with "#:eof", so it is truncated or not from LASTZ' >&2 && exit 1 ) ) && ( test -s '$input' || ( : > '$output' && : > scores.txt ) ) && ( test ! -s '$input' || lavToPsl $output_format $target_strand -scoreFile=scores.txt '$input' '$output' )

param.name: target_strand
param.label: Strand column
param.help: (-target-strand) PSL output only. Write the query strand only (+ or -), or add the target strand as a second character (++ or -+).

param.name: output_scores
param.label: Also output alignment scores
param.help: (-scoreFile) The LASTZ score of each alignment, one per line, in the same order as the alignments.

tool.help:
**What it does**
`lavToPsl`_ converts pairwise alignments from LASTZ's `LAV`_ format to `PSL`_ or `BED12`_. Each alignment becomes one line. UCSC's pairwise alignment pipeline (``doBlastzChainNet.pl``) gives the PSL to ``axtChain``, which builds chains from it. PSL holds the alignment coordinates but no sequence, so it is much smaller than AXT.
**Input**
LASTZ output in LAV format. One file can hold several LASTZ runs, one after the other. An empty file gives empty outputs. If the file does not end with the LASTZ ``#:eof`` line, it is incomplete and the tool stops with an error.
**Options**
- **Output format**: PSL, or BED12 with the query name as the feature name. - **Strand column** (PSL only): by default the PSL strand column holds the query strand (``+`` or ``-``). The second choice adds the target strand, which is always ``+`` for LASTZ. - **Also output alignment scores**: a second dataset with the LASTZ score of each alignment, one per line, in the order of the alignments.
**Output**
PSL or BED12. For each LASTZ run in the input, the output has a block of ``##`` comment lines. These lines show the LASTZ command line and scoring matrix.
For implementation details see lavToPsl's `source code`_.
.. _lavToPsl: http://hgdownload.cse.ucsc.edu/admin/exe/linux.x86_64/FOOTER.txt .. _LAV: https://lastz.github.io/lastz/#fmt_lav .. _PSL: https://genome.ucsc.edu/FAQ/FAQformat.html#format2 .. _BED12: https://genome.ucsc.edu/FAQ/FAQformat.html#format1 .. _source code: https://github.com/ucscGenomeBrowser/kent/blob/master/src/hg/mouseStuff/lavToPsl/lavToPsl.c
